$team..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name', 'score', 'answered', 'startedAt']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 28 && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 100 && newData.child('answered').isNumber() && newData.child('answered').val() <= 10

$id..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name', 'score', 'time']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length >= 1 && newData.child('name').val().length <= 16 && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 100000 && newData.child('time').isNumber() && newData.child('time').val() >= 0 && newData.child('time').val() <= 7200
